protocol_label: VALU demo subset v1 — adapted protocol

ADC.note: No single pooled ADC accuracy is reported as a headline: the three subtasks have different option sets and semantics.

TDG.definition: tIoU = intersection / union of the predicted and reference single span; invalid, missing or truncated predictions score 0.

ALD.note: No description score is computed in v1. No BLEU/ROUGE or LLM judge is used.

latency.note: Peak value is torch allocated memory for the request, not total device memory usage. Model loading and checkpoint download are excluded from latency.
